findings.issue: The body after the auth check is printed twice, once per arm of the caller test, differing only in the memory base of the return-data copy (P12); the returned value and the event data stay memory reads (mem[_30 + 96]) although they are word 3 of vat.ilks' return data.
findings.rule: Merge identical code that follows a branch when the two copies differ only by a value that can be bound to a phi (_30 = mem[64] or 128); fold reads of a return-data copy mem[b + k] (k + 32 <= checked size) to ext_call.return_data[k].

notes: No loops. All functions read: owner/authority/autoLine getters, addIlk/delIlk (unknownf2dd3992/unknownb9b422d9), setOwner, setAuthority, file('autoLine'), wipe (DSAuth-style isAuthorized: this, owner, authority.canCall(caller, this, msg.sig); the call-buffer stores before canCall are dead, P8). vat is an immutable read as 0 (calls to 0x0). Unknown event topics print raw.
summary: Small, faithful and readable; only wipe's body is duplicated across the auth branch and its return value stays a memory read.
